# C2 sync service notice

Updated 2026-07-22. The C2 cloud sync shutdown for pre-2019 bodies is now set for 2026-10-31, moved back to follow the August firmware window. After that date the sync client stops accepting those serial ranges.

turns.prompt: Our rental shelf still has two pre-2019 Fenstanton bodies syncing through C2, and the front desk wants the real end date on the booking sheet. On what date does the vendor's service notice say the C2 sync shutdown is set? Give the date alone, in the form YYYY-MM-DD.
